svg.title: The access link: how a home or office reaches the internet
svg.desc: Inside the premises, laptops, phones, and desktops connect to a Wi-Fi router. The gateway, a cable modem or optical network terminal, is the demarcation point with the provider. The link to the ISP is one of four kinds: coaxial cable with DOCSIS, a shared medium; fiber over a passive optical network such as GPON or XGS-PON; 5G fixed wireless access; or low-earth-orbit satellite. The ISP then connects to the internet.
